correctness.rationale: For any tuple, its generated Boolean subalgebra is exactly the partition algebra of equality of all temporal itineraries, since both inverse permutation automorphisms are available. On each l-cycle, distinction is equivalent to a primitive q-ary necklace; between distinct cycles it requires pairwise distinct primitive necklace classes of the same length. This yields the exact conditional product l^c (L_l(q))_c. Averaging using permutation cycle types gives product_l(1+z^l)^{L_l(q)}, which by standard Witt identity equals (1-qz^2)/(1-qz). Extract coefficients n>=2 and divide by n!q^n to obtain 1-1/q. Boundary n=1 is separately treated; finite checker independently enumerates 948 cases and coefficient totals.

value.rationale: The number of predicates needed to separate every finite possible world by iterated past/future observations is a natural structural problem for modal/tense models. Conditional generation depends sharply on the frame cycle type (sometimes impossible), yet the joint uniform model has exact n-independent success probability. This identifies a genuine logical-dynamical invariant with a closed conditional census and exposes an unexpected correspondence to squarefree polynomials. Not merely a relabelling of a numeric sequence because the itinerary equivalence and generator count are substantive logical interpretations.
